name: Apollo Lunar Rovers
tagline: Three electric explorers rolled across the Moon—and were parked there when their astronauts headed home.
imageAlt: Illustrated archive portrait of Apollo Lunar Rovers
credit: Original editorial illustration created for the Left Behind archive.

beats.goal: Help Apollo astronauts travel farther across the Moon than was possible on foot.
beats.achieved: The Lunar Roving Vehicles carried astronauts and scientific equipment during Apollo 15, 16, and 17, greatly increasing the distance explored and the amount of lunar material collected.
beats.ending: After each mission ended, the rovers were parked on the Moon because there was no space or fuel to return them to Earth. They have remained there ever since.
beats.now: All three Lunar Roving Vehicles still rest on the Moon near their respective Apollo landing sites.
beats.learned: The rovers demonstrated the value of mobile exploration on planetary surfaces and inspired the design of future robotic and human exploration vehicles.
